aa.label: Ask the Agent
aa.name: Ask the Agent about {{subject}}
aa.title: Ask the Agent about {{subject}}
aa.on: Starts a new conversation with the Agent on {{computer}}. The answer shows in the Agent panel.
aa.onShown: Starts a new conversation with the Agent on the computer shown now. The answer shows in the Agent panel.
aa.waiting: Waiting for the Agent panel to take this.
aa.sent: Asked. The answer is in the Agent panel.
aa.notSent: Nothing reached the Agent. Your words are kept: you can ask again.
aa.unknown: This may have reached the Agent. Look in the Agent panel before you ask again.
aa.unread: The details couldn't be read, so nothing was sent to the Agent. Try again.
aa.held: Asking is paused so the same question is not sent twice.
aa.releaseBody: If it reached the Agent, asking again asks a second time. Stop tracking only after you looked in the Agent panel.
